tagline: A super community bank model focused on high-quality client relationships and operational efficiency across the Pacific Northwest
hero_kpi_rationale: Primary revenue driver in the traditional banking model, reflecting the efficiency of productive asset deployment. Increase of 21 bps to 3.96% in 2025 demonstrates effective deposit base management despite an uncertain rate environment.

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between interest income and borrowing costs, expressed as a percentage of interest-earning assets.
kpis.description: The net interest margin increased to 3.96% in 2025 from 3.75% in 2024, reflecting effective management of the deposit base and productive assets.
kpis.signal: Margin expansion despite an uncertain rate environment

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Sum of interest income and non-interest income.
kpis.description: Total revenue reached $660.7 million in 2025, up 8.6% from $608.6 million in 2024, driven by net interest margin and stable fee income.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income reached $195.4 million in 2025, compared to $168.9 million in 2024, supported by revenue growth and disciplined cost management.

kpis.name: Return on Assets
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by average total assets.
kpis.description: ROA improved to 1.21% in 2025 from 1.07% in 2024, indicating more efficient use of assets.

kpis.name: Efficiency Ratio
kpis.explanation: Non-interest expenses divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: The efficiency ratio declined to 61.87% in 2025 from 64.33% in 2024, signaling improved cost control.

kpis.name: Loan Portfolio
kpis.explanation: Total amount of loans extended to customers.
kpis.description: The loan portfolio reached $11.56 billion at end-2025, up 3.2% from $11.20 billion at end-2024.

kpis.name: Deposit Base
kpis.explanation: Total customer deposits, the primary funding source.
kpis.description: Deposits totaled $13.74 billion at end-2025, up from $13.51 billion in 2024, with 89% in core deposits.

kpis.name: Headcount
kpis.description: Headcount reached 1,943 full-time equivalents at end-2025, down 13 from 1,956 in 2024.

kpis.name: Core Deposits
kpis.explanation: Proportion of stable deposits within total deposits.
kpis.description: Core deposits represented 89% of total deposits at end-2025, reflecting a stable funding composition.

kpis.name: Non-Performing Assets
kpis.explanation: Loans in default or repayment difficulty, expressed as a percentage of total assets.
kpis.description: Non-performing assets accounted for 0.31% of total assets at end-2025, up from 0.24% in 2024, reflecting moderate pressure on portfolio quality.

kpis.name: Dividends Per Share
kpis.explanation: Total dividends paid per share during the fiscal year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Annual total: dividends paid + share buybacks.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends and buybacks (2021-2025) in USD billions. Source: yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Portion of net income distributed. >80% = potentially unsustainable.

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Measures the company's ability to generate profit per share: basis for Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Adverse economic conditions affecting regional markets
risks.summary: Economic slowdowns in key regions where the bank operates (particularly Puget Sound and Eastern Washington) could harm its financial performance, liquidity, and outlook.
risks.score_rationale: This risk is listed first in the 'Risks Related to Macroeconomic Conditions' section. The language used is strong ('material adverse effect') and highlights significant geographic concentration (Washington, Oregon, California, Idaho), making the company vulnerable to regional economic downturns. The weighting is high because macroeconomic conditions are fundamental for a bank. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risks related to commercial and multifamily real estate loans
risks.summary: The significant portfolio of commercial real estate loans is exposed to risks of higher vacancy, refinancing difficulties, and declining values, exacerbated by changes in work models and interest rates.
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed in the 'Risks Related to Credit and Lending' section and represents 42% of the loan portfolio. The language intensity is high, citing default risks, refinancing challenges due to interest rates and work model shifts (remote work). The portfolio's high weighting and commercial real estate market specifics justify a high severity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Risks related to construction and land development loans
risks.summary: Construction and land development loans carry high risks related to cost estimation, future property values, and real estate market volatility, potentially leading to significant losses.
risks.score_rationale: This risk is explicitly detailed in the 'Risks Related to Credit and Lending' section, representing 15% of the portfolio. The language is intense, emphasizing uncertainties in cost and future value estimates, risks of exceeding commitments, and sensitivity to real estate market slowdowns. The speculative nature of some loans and concentration among certain developers increases severity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Impact of monetary policy and interest rates
risks.summary: Interest rate fluctuations directly affect net interest margin, asset yields, and funding costs, creating revenue and profitability volatility.
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned in the 'Risks Related to Macroeconomic Conditions' section and directly impacts bank profitability. Uncertainty around Federal Reserve rate changes and their impact on credit demand, asset yields, and deposit costs is emphasized. While less specific than a portfolio risk, systemic exposure justifies a moderate to high severity. (default score, to be refined)
